column1: # The stock default.csv gives each OTA app slot 0x140000 (1.31 MB) and hands
# 1.44 MB to SPIFFS. This firmware never uses SPIFFS — bulk storage is the SD
# card and settings live in NVS — so that space is reclaimed to enlarge both
# app slots to 0x1D0000 (1.9 MB). Without this
# top of the Bluedroid BLE stack does not fit in an app slot.
# background reference and settings survive this change.
# Two app slots are mandatory for OTA: the running image is never overwritten
# the update is written to the inactive slot and only then booted.
